match.$comment: An entry matches only with a non-empty destination criterion (domains / domain_suffixes / cidrs), OR as a constraint-only entry pinning BOTH processes and ports/local_ports (P2P-class traffic, e.g. Delivery Optimization 7680) - see classify.psm1 Test-WhitelistMatch. Anything else is inert (never matches). Deliberately NOT enforced here: one inert entry must not fail the whole file (Get-Whitelist would refuse to start without a last-good copy); Get-Whitelist logs a WARN per inert entry instead.

domains.description: exact FQDN matches, lowercase, no trailing dot

domain_suffixes.description: matches domain == suffix or domain endswith '.'+suffix

cidrs.description: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR; only for traffic with no domain (e.g. Telegram DC range, Tailscale-internal)

processes.description: owning process names (no .exe, lowercase); empty/absent = any process

local_ports.description: local ports; mainly for inbound entries (e.g. RDP 3389)
